title: Verb ていただきたい (te itadakitai)
shortExplanation: Express a polite request or desire that someone does something for you.
longExplanation: The ていただきたい grammar point is used to express a polite request or a desire for someone to do something for you. It is formed by attaching いただきたい to the て-form of the verb. It is more polite than the て-form + ほしい construction.
formation: Verb-て form + いただきたい

examples.jp: 資料をコピーしていただきたいです。
examples.romaji: Shiryou wo kopii shite itadakitai desu.
examples.en: I would like you to make copies of the documents.

examples.jp: この仕事を手伝っていただきたいのですが。
examples.romaji: Kono shigoto wo tetsudatte itadakitai no desu ga.
examples.en: I would like to ask for your assistance with this work.

examples.jp: もしよろしければ、指導していただきたいです。
examples.romaji: Moshi yoroshikereba, shidou shite itadakitai desu.
examples.en: If it is not too much trouble, I would like you to guide me.

examples.jp: 駅まで送っていただきたいんですが。
examples.romaji: Eki made okutte itadakitain desu ga.
examples.en: I was wondering if you could give me a ride to the station.
